# Generated by eu5autobuild.generator.
monthly_country_pulse = {
	on_actions = {
		eu5ab_monthly_country_policy_pulse
	}
}

eu5ab_monthly_country_policy_pulse = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_human = yes
				var:eu5ab_global_enabled > 0
				any_owned_location = { has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id }
				NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_active }
			}
			# Start on day 2, spread expensive scoring over twenty daily buckets,
			# then finalize the construction queue on day 22.
			trigger_event_silently = {
				id = eu5ab_monthly.1
				days = 1
			}
		}
	}
}

# Each location invocation is an independent task when the engine dispatches
# this events block. The worker event writes only to its root location.
eu5ab_parallel_location_scan_on_action = {
	events = {
		eu5ab_worker.1
	}
}

on_location_changed_owner = {
	on_actions = {
		eu5ab_on_location_changed_owner
	}
}

eu5ab_on_location_changed_owner = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket }
			scope:loser ?= {
				switch = {
					trigger = root.var:eu5ab_scan_bucket
					1 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_1_locations target = root } }
					2 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_2_locations target = root } }
					3 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_3_locations target = root } }
					4 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_4_locations target = root } }
					5 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_5_locations target = root } }
					6 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_6_locations target = root } }
					7 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_7_locations target = root } }
					8 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_8_locations target = root } }
					9 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_9_locations target = root } }
					10 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_10_locations target = root } }
					11 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_11_locations target = root } }
					12 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_12_locations target = root } }
					13 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_13_locations target = root } }
					14 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_14_locations target = root } }
					15 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_15_locations target = root } }
					16 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_16_locations target = root } }
					17 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_17_locations target = root } }
					18 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_18_locations target = root } }
					19 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_19_locations target = root } }
					20 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_20_locations target = root } }
				}
			}
			remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id scope:winner ?= { is_human = yes } }
			eu5ab_register_location_for_scan = yes
		}
	}
}

# Register the Mod and its conflict-free window entry point with CMF.

	on_actions = {
		eu5ab_on_cmf_registration
	}
}

# CMF dispatches action-bar clicks through a shared callback.
cmf_on_callback = {
	on_actions = {
		eu5ab_on_cmf_callback
	}
}

eu5ab_on_cmf_callback = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_action_bar }
			set_variable = eu5ab_cmf_window_requested
			remove_variable = eu5ab_active_preset_policy
			eu5ab_select_first_player_template = yes
		}
		# CMM auto-apply fires the same callback with the composite setting key.
		if = {
			limit = { var:cmf_callback != flag:eu5ab_action_bar }
			if = {
				limit = { var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__performance_preset }
				switch = {
					trigger = "variable_map(cmm|flag:eu5ab_regional_development__performance_preset)"
					1 = {
						add_to_variable_map = { name = cmm key = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__parallel_location_scan value = 1 }
						add_to_variable_map = { name = cmm key = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__daily_location_task_limit value = 10 }
						add_to_variable_map = { name = cmm key = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__max_additions_per_run value = 30 }
						add_to_variable_map = { name = cmm key = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__early_stop_when_candidates_sufficient value = 1 }
					}
					2 = {
						add_to_variable_map = { name = cmm key = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__parallel_location_scan value = 1 }
						add_to_variable_map = { name = cmm key = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__daily_location_task_limit value = 20 }
						add_to_variable_map = { name = cmm key = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__max_additions_per_run value = 50 }
						add_to_variable_map = { name = cmm key = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__early_stop_when_candidates_sufficient value = 1 }
					}
					3 = {
						add_to_variable_map = { name = cmm key = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__parallel_location_scan value = 1 }
						add_to_variable_map = { name = cmm key = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__daily_location_task_limit value = 30 }
						add_to_variable_map = { name = cmm key = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__max_additions_per_run value = 0 }
						add_to_variable_map = { name = cmm key = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__early_stop_when_candidates_sufficient value = 1 }
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__parallel_location_scan
						var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__daily_location_task_limit
						var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__max_additions_per_run
						var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__early_stop_when_candidates_sufficient
					}
				}
				add_to_variable_map = { name = cmm key = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__performance_preset value = 4 }
			}
			# CMM's stock Shift gesture jumps to min/max. Reinterpret those endpoint
			# writes as the larger step documented by this Mod's tooltips.
			if = {
				limit = { var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__monthly_build_hard_cap }
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_global_monthly_build_hard_cap }
					if = {
						limit = { "variable_map(cmm|flag:eu5ab_regional_development__monthly_build_hard_cap)" = 599 var:eu5ab_global_monthly_build_hard_cap < 599 }
						set_variable = { name = eu5ab_cmm_shift_step value = { value = var:eu5ab_global_monthly_build_hard_cap add = 10 max = 599 } }
						add_to_variable_map = { name = cmm key = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__monthly_build_hard_cap value = var:eu5ab_cmm_shift_step }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { "variable_map(cmm|flag:eu5ab_regional_development__monthly_build_hard_cap)" = 0 var:eu5ab_global_monthly_build_hard_cap > 0 }
						set_variable = { name = eu5ab_cmm_shift_step value = { value = var:eu5ab_global_monthly_build_hard_cap subtract = 10 min = 0 } }
						add_to_variable_map = { name = cmm key = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__monthly_build_hard_cap value = var:eu5ab_cmm_shift_step }
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__fixed_annual_budget }
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_global_fixed_annual_budget }
					if = {
						limit = { "variable_map(cmm|flag:eu5ab_regional_development__fixed_annual_budget)" = 999999 var:eu5ab_global_fixed_annual_budget < 999999 }
						set_variable = { name = eu5ab_cmm_shift_step value = { value = var:eu5ab_global_fixed_annual_budget add = 1000 max = 999999 } }
						add_to_variable_map = { name = cmm key = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__fixed_annual_budget value = var:eu5ab_cmm_shift_step }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { "variable_map(cmm|flag:eu5ab_regional_development__fixed_annual_budget)" = 0 var:eu5ab_global_fixed_annual_budget > 0 }
						set_variable = { name = eu5ab_cmm_shift_step value = { value = var:eu5ab_global_fixed_annual_budget subtract = 1000 min = 0 } }
						add_to_variable_map = { name = cmm key = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__fixed_annual_budget value = var:eu5ab_cmm_shift_step }
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__min_cash_reserve }
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_global_min_cash_reserve }
					if = {
						limit = { "variable_map(cmm|flag:eu5ab_regional_development__min_cash_reserve)" = 100000 var:eu5ab_global_min_cash_reserve < 100000 }
						set_variable = { name = eu5ab_cmm_shift_step value = { value = var:eu5ab_global_min_cash_reserve add = 1000 max = 100000 } }
						add_to_variable_map = { name = cmm key = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__min_cash_reserve value = var:eu5ab_cmm_shift_step }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { "variable_map(cmm|flag:eu5ab_regional_development__min_cash_reserve)" = 0 var:eu5ab_global_min_cash_reserve > 0 }
						set_variable = { name = eu5ab_cmm_shift_step value = { value = var:eu5ab_global_min_cash_reserve subtract = 1000 min = 0 } }
						add_to_variable_map = { name = cmm key = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__min_cash_reserve value = var:eu5ab_cmm_shift_step }
					}
				}
			}
			remove_variable = eu5ab_cmm_shift_step
			eu5ab_sync_cmm_settings = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__budget_mode
						var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__fixed_annual_budget
					}
				}
				eu5ab_refresh_global_budget = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# The GUI bridge variable is saved by the engine; do not reopen a window merely
# because the player saved while it was visible.
on_game_load_after_lobby_human_country = {
	on_actions = {
		eu5ab_on_cmf_after_load
	}
}

eu5ab_on_cmf_after_load = {
	effect = {
		remove_variable = eu5ab_cmf_window_requested
		eu5ab_recover_runtime_after_load = yes
		eu5ab_sync_cmm_settings = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_global_budget_remaining } }
			eu5ab_refresh_global_budget = yes
		}
	}
}
